comment: Receipts recorded on Arc mainnet by the reference service. Listed by transaction hash rather than discovered by scanning: the public RPC rejects eth_getLogs over more than ~5,000 blocks, and at 0.5s per block the gap from the registry's deployment grows by ~172,800 blocks a day. Appended by scripts/record-receipt.mjs.
apiComment: Base URL of the live service. null hides the interactive demo. Append ?api=http://localhost:3000 to the page URL to drive it against a local service.

receipts.note: 12.03 MB GLB in, 0.48 MB out. 12 triangles and 24 vertices both ways.
Sponsored demo run. Same pipeline, same receipt; the provider paid the gas.
